# 难以预料的机械故障 / Unforeseeable Mechanical Failure

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：`events/machine_age_situation_events_1.txt:3178-3360`；`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt`

## 如何开始 How it starts

- “未来冲击”事件链中段：网络化局势结束后 cyber.500 选出 505–525 之一，约180+随机90天后隐藏事件 cyber.600 从 on_futureshock_chain_work_family_events_list（11个事件，权重各5：工作 610/615/625/655，家庭 805/810/815/820/830/840/855）抽取一个。
  Middle of the "Future Shock" event chain: after the Cyberization situation ends cyber.500 picks one of 505-525; about 180 days (+ random 90) later hidden cyber.600 draws one event from on_futureshock_chain_work_family_events_list (11 events, weight 5 each: work 610/615/625/655, family 805/810/815/820/830/840/855).
- 触发：帝国没有国家标志 cyber_control_independent，没有“共担”政体，也不是工人合作社。
  Trigger: the empire has no cyber_control_independent flag, no Shared Burden civic and is not a worker co-op.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 655「不可预见的机械故障」：a 每月团结（无风险）；b 获得 worse_parts，5% 概率 90+随机90天后 660「不可预见的社会故障」；c 获得能量与 worse_parts，30% 概率进入 660；d 采用 optimized_parts。无660时180+随机90天后 cyber.1000。
  655 "Unforeseeable Mechanical Failure": a monthly unity (no risk); b worse_parts with a 5% chance of 660 "Unforeseeable Societal Failure" after 90 days (+ random 90); c energy and worse_parts with a 30% chance of 660; d optimized_parts. Without 660, cyber.1000 follows after 180 days (+ random 90).
- 660：移除 worse_parts，或 discontent 修正（巨型企业付500团结，警察国家/反乌托邦有版本）；之后90+随机90天由 cyber.1000 衔接。
  660: removes worse_parts, or a discontent modifier (megacorps pay 500 unity; Police State / Dystopian have variants); cyber.1000 follows after 90 days (+ random 90).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 660 只在选项 b/c 的随机分支中出现。
  660 appears only in the random branches of options b and c.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 巨型企业与警察国家等政体在660有专属选项。
  Megacorps and Police State / Dystopian civics get their own options in 660.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：触发、概率（5/95、30/70）、660 的选项与衔接。
  Checked: trigger, probabilities (5/95, 30/70), options of 660 and the link-up.
